Name: Adrammelech
Summary: Adrammelech was a son of Sennacherib who, with his brother Sharezer, murdered his father as he worshipped in the house of Nisroch and fled to Ararat.
KeyStory: After Sennacherib returned to Nineveh, his sons Adrammelech and Sharezer struck him down with the sword in the temple of his god.
LifeLesson: A king who mocked God found no safety even in his own god's house.
